items.q: Burt Bailey, Norman Mason and, that was the saxophones, Burt Bailey Norman Mason and old man Kimbal was on bass.

ctx.x: I can check these spellings, don't worry.

Burt Bailey, Norman Mason and, that was the saxophones, Burt Bailey Norman Mason and old man Kimbal was on bass. And Willie Foster, George's brother was on banjo. And they had a little cat out of Paducah played violin and peck horn. See, he was on, he was on, in that band.
See, then later we put on an extra piano player, Lovingood, see and he played, that's when they played all of Jelly Roll's stuff you know." The Pearls, and I mean correct, see.
